# Sunrise Sunset

> > Comprehensive sunrise, sunset, and astronomical data for locations across Australia, including twilight times, moon phases, and solar calendar information.

Sunrise Sunset provides detailed solar and lunar timing information for cities and towns throughout Australia, covering multiple time zones (AEDT, AWST) and states including New South Wales, Victoria, and Western Australia. The site offers practical astronomical data including daylight hours, twilight periods, solstice information, and moon phase calendars for planning and reference.

## Key Topics

- Sunrise and sunset times
- Astronomical data
- Solar calendar
- Daylight hours
- Twilight times
- Moon phases
- Solstice information
- AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
- AWST (Australian Western Standard Time)
- New South Wales
- Victoria
- Western Australia
- Golden hour timing
- Civil twilight
- Nautical twilight

## Australian Location Data

- [Golden Bay-Singleton, Western Australia Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/golden-bay-singleton): Sunrise/sunset times for Golden Bay-Singleton, Western Australia (AWST)
- [Kensington, New South Wales Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/kensington): Sunrise/sunset times for Kensington, NSW with twilight & solar data
- [Greenwell Point, New South Wales Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/greenwell-point): Sunrise/sunset times for Greenwell Point, NSW with moon phases
- [Somers, New South Wales Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/somers-new-south-): Sunrise/sunset times for Somers, NSW with solstice information
- [Hoppers Crossing, Victoria Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/hoppers-crossing): Sunrise/sunset times for Hoppers Crossing, Victoria (AEDT)
- [Bellarwi, New South Wales Sunrise and Sunset Times](https://sunrise-sunset.org/au/bellarwi): Sunrise/sunset times for Bellarwi, NSW with daylight hours
